verdict.rationale: Autumn has a first-party webhooks documentation page with at least one event type, fired whenever a customer's plans change (new subscriptions, upgrades, downgrades). The docs position webhooks for triggering workflows and syncing with external systems, so the core story is delivered. Missing for 10: documented endpoint registration and configuration flow, a full event catalog beyond plan changes, signature verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
